description: Candidate single-Spark binding for Tencent's exact UI-Mate 27B checkpoint, official prompt/parser/action harness, and OpenAI-compatible vLLM server. It returns non-actuating action proposals only: a caller or operator must supply the screenshot/action loop and approve and execute actions externally. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: UI-Mate 27B BF16 vLLM single Spark
